[[File:Pzobbase.jpg|thumb|right|The ruins of the stormtrooper base on Pzob.]]
This '''military base''' on the planet [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]] was built to temporarily house a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The original plan was for the troopers to be picked up by the enormous [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''; however, when the ship was sabotaged by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] intervention, the stormtroopers became stranded on Pzob. Over the years, most of the soldiers were killed by either skirmishes with the local [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clans or infighting. The sole survivor was [[Triv Pothman]], who remained in the ruined base until [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when the reactivated ''Eye of Palpatine'' retrieved him.
